recipes.name: 10 Levels of Cheesesteak
ingredients: salt and freshly ground black pepper, to taste
1/2 cup Cheese Whiz or 4 slices white American cheese
instructions: For Level 4: Cheesesteak Kit Style:
Heat vegetable oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. - 1 tbsp vegetable oil
Add diced onion and cook for 3–4 minutes until softened and lightly caramelized. - 1 small yellow onion diced
Add thin sliced beef and cook for 4–5 minutes until browned. - 1 lb thin sliced beef (Steak umms)
Reduce heat to low and sprinkle mozzarella cheese over the beef mixture. - ½ cup shredded mozzarella cheese
Cover for 1 minute until the cheese melts completely.
Transfer filling into warmed rolls and serve hot. - 2 sandwich rolls
For Level 5: Classic Homemade Cheesesteak:
For the Filling
Heat oil in a cast iron skillet over medium-high heat. - 1 tbsp vegetable oil
Add onion and bell pepper and cook for 5–6 minutes until softened. - 1 yellow onion sliced - 1 green bell pepper sliced
Push vegetables to one side and add shaved beef. - 1 lb shaved beef
Cook beef for 3–4 minutes, chopping with the spatula as it cooks.
Season with salt and black pepper. - salt and freshly ground black pepper to taste
For the Assembly
Split the hoagie rolls and lightly scoop out some interior bread to create a cavity. - 2 large hoagie rolls
Add Cheese Whiz to the inside of the rolls or place American cheese over the beef to melt. - ½ cup Cheese Whiz or 4 slices white American cheese
Fill each roll with the beef mixture.
Wrap tightly in foil and rest for 3–5 minutes before serving.Heat vegetable oil in a skillet over medium-high heat.
Add diced onion and cook for 3–4 minutes until softened and lightly caramelized.
Add thin sliced beef and cook for 4–5 minutes until browned.
Reduce heat to low and sprinkle mozzarella cheese over the beef mixture.
Cover for 1 minute until the cheese melts completely.
Transfer filling into warmed rolls and serve hot.
For Level 6: Chicken Cheesesteak:
For the Marinade

Combine soy sauce, Worcestershire sauce, garlic powder, and onion powder in a small bowl. Whisk until homogenous. - 1 tbsp soy sauce - 1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce - ½ tsp garlic powder - ½ tsp onion powder
For the Chicken
On a baking sheet, dry brine chicken thighs with salt and let it sit at room temperature for 20 to 30 minutes before searing. - 1 lb boneless skinless chicken thighs - 1 tsp kosher salt
Slice the onion and bell pepper. - 1 onion sliced - 1 bell pepper sliced
Heat skillet over medium-high heat and sear chicken for 4–5 minutes per side.
Allow chicken to rest for 5 minutes, then slice thinly. Set aside.
For the Fillings
Cook onion and bell pepper in oil until softened. - 1 tbsp vegetable oil
Add sliced chicken and marinade then toss together.
For the Assembly
Top with cheese, kill the heat, and cover allowing the cheese to melt. - 4 slices white American cheese
Transfer to rolls, wrap in aluminum foil, then serve after 5 minutes. - 2 hoagie rolls
For Level 7: Proper Homemade Cheesesteak:
Place skirt steak in the freezer for 45–60 minutes until very firm but not frozen solid. - 1 lb skirt steak
Using a mandoline or sharp knife, slice very thinly against the grain.
Season lightly with kosher salt. - 1 tsp kosher salt
For the Filling
Cook onions on a hot griddle until softened and lightly browned. - 1 onion sliced
Add sliced beef and cook for 1–2 minutes over high heat.
For the Assembly
Top beef with cheeses and allow to melt. - 4 slices white American cheese - 2 slices provolone cheese
Transfer to rolls and serve hot. - 2 hoagie rolls
For Level 8: Shop-Style Ribeye Cheesesteak:
Cook onions on griddle until softened and caramelized. - 1 yellow onion sliced
Add ribeye and cook rapidly over high heat while chopping finely. - 1 lb shaved ribeye
Mix onions into beef.
Top with cheese and allow to melt fully into meat. - 4 slices white American cheese
Pile into rolls and wrap tightly for 3 minutes before serving. - 2 high quality hoagie rolls
For Level 9: Korean Bulgogi Cheesesteak:
Combine marinade ingredients in a bowl. - ¼ cup soy sauce - 2 tbsp brown sugar - 2 tbsp sesame oil - ¼ cup pineapple juice - 2 cloves garlic minced - ½ onion grated
Add sliced beef and marinate for at least 2 hours. - 1 lb thin sliced ribeye
Cook quickly in skillet over high heat until caramelized.
Top with provolone and melt. - 4 slices provolone
Transfer to rolls and top with pickled chilies. - 2 sandwich rolls - pickled chilies
Serve immediately.
For Level 10: Ultimate Prime Ribeye Cheesesteak:
Dry brine ribeye roast uncovered in refrigerator for 24–48 hours. - 2 lb prime ribeye roast - 2 tsp kosher salt
Roast at 275 °F until internal temperature reaches 110 °F.
Cool completely and slice very thin.
Simmer bones, onion, and water for 1–2 hours to create broth. - rib bones - 1 onion halved - 4 cups water
Heat broth to a gentle simmer.
Briefly sear beef slices, then dip in broth to finish cooking.
For the cheese sauce, heat milk and sodium citrate, then melt in cheeses until smooth. - 6 oz milk - ½ tsp sodium citrate - 12 oz white American cheese - 4 oz provolone
Toast rolls lightly. - 4 hoagie rolls
Layer cheese sauce, pepper relish, and hot beef into rolls. - pickled hot pepper relish
Wrap tightly and rest 5 minutes before serving.
